title: Find the league name that had the highest percentage of matches with total
question: Find the league name that had the highest percentage of matches with total goals (home + away) exceeding the average total goals per match in the 2014/2015 season, among leagues that played at least 100 matches.

prediction.sql:
WITH match_data AS (
  SELECT 
    l.XCL_005 AS league_name,
    m.XCL_015 + m.XCL_016 AS total_goals
  FROM Match m
  INNER JOIN League l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2014/2015'
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_goals) AS avg_goals
  FROM match_data
),
league_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    md.league_name,
    COUNT(*) AS match_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN md.total_goals > ga.avg_goals THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_exceeding
  FROM match_data md
  CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
  GROUP BY md.league_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
)
SELECT league_name
FROM league_stats
ORDER BY pct_exceeding DESC
LIMIT 1
